name: Remote Monitoring
author: OmniPull Team
description: A lightweight FastAPI server that exposes your download list over HTTP. View real-time progress from any device on your network via a polished Tailwind CSS dashboard — no extra software required.

name: Auto Organiser
author: Community
description: Automatically moves completed downloads into subfolders categorised by file type, date, or custom rules. Keeps your Downloads directory tidy.

name: Speed Analytics
author: Community
description: Tracks per-download bandwidth history and renders beautiful inline sparklines. Export CSV reports or visualise weekly throughput trends.
